Available October 23 at 1pm ET
2026 Topps Holiday Football
Unwrap festive football fun with rookies, stars, and holiday-inspired designs.
Get notified
Download checklist
About the release

2026 Topps Holiday Football brings the magic of the season to the field, pairing festive creativity with the excitement of a new NFL season. The release showcases the highly anticipated 2026 rookie class alongside fan-favorite veterans, giving Collectors the opportunity to chase the players defining today’s game through a distinctly holiday-inspired lens.

Throughout the product, Collectors can discover unique holiday-inspired parallels, variations, and subsets that bring an unexpected seasonal spin to football collecting. New additions like Rookies Holiday Spirit Variation put a festive spotlight on the league’s newest stars, while Snow Globe Moments celebrates memorable players and moments through an all-new winter-inspired design. From established stars to the next generation of talent, 2026 Topps Holiday Football delivers a playful collecting experience unlike anything else in the Topps portfolio.

Whether you’re chasing your favorite rookie, collecting your team, or looking for something completely different to rip this holiday season, 2026 Topps Holiday Football brings together the excitement of football and the spirit of the holidays in every pack.

What to look for
Base Holiday Spirit Variation

Base Holiday Spirit Variations deck out the base set with festive designs and seasonal imagery featuring top NFL stars.

Dear Santa

Dear Santa is an autograph relic subset that reimagines the traditional card as a playful holiday letter, featuring a Santa-inspired autograph area where players sign their “wish list” for the season.

Hidden Elf

Random Elfs located around the player, flushed into the base design.

Rookie Holiday Spirit Variation

Short print of top rookies, with a unique variety of flannel holiday design.

About the brand

Topps Holiday brings a seasonal twist to the collecting experience, combining the excitement of the sport with festive, holiday-inspired designs. The product offers collectors a fun and approachable way to engage with their favorite athletes while incorporating unique seasonal elements throughout the set. With a mix of familiar names, standout players, and holiday-themed details, Topps Holiday provides an engaging collecting experience that can appeal to both longtime collectors and fans looking to celebrate the season.

It’s more than a set. It’s a celebration. Whether you’re ripping packs by the fireplace or gifting the joy of collecting, Topps Holiday makes every pull feel magical.

guides.text: Topps Holiday Football Product History The Story of Topps Holiday Football DEBUT YEAR: 2026 LICENSORS: NFL VALUE LEVEL: ACCESSIBLE Topps Holiday brings a festive twist to the collecting calendar, and for 2026, that seasonal spin reaches football for the first time. 2026 Topps Holiday Football pairs a new rookie class with the wintry designs and mega box format Topps Holiday has used in baseball and basketball, making it a perfect seasonal pickup for gridiron collectors. DISCOVER TOPPS HOLIDAY FOOTBALL With a wide range of colorful holiday parallels and festive inserts, 2026 Topps Holiday Football expands one of The Hobby’s favorite winter brands for collectors old and new. 2026 Topps Holiday Football is the first Topps Holiday release built for the NFL. The set pairs the Flagship Football design with festive parallels and inserts like Snow Globe Moments, Deck the Fields, Frozen Fields, and Dear Santa, bringing holiday cheer to the Football Hobby in style. The History Behind Topps Holiday Topps Holiday started as a Walmart-exclusive baseball release in 2016, taking the flagship Topps Baseball design and dressing it up for the season with snowy card fronts, ornament die-cuts, and festive parallels. New additions deck the brand every year, giving collectors something special to look forward to every year as the weather turns cold. The brand carried that same formula into basketball for the 2025-26 season, marking the first time Topps Holiday appeared outside baseball. Now, 2026 Topps Holiday Football extends the tradition to a third sport. Previous Next Why Topps Holiday Football Matters This is the first time football fans get the Topps Holiday treatment. The brand adds a lighter, more casual entry point to close out the football card season, making it a great pick for family rips or as a gift for younger collectors. Because Holiday releases lean on that year’s rookie class, 2026 Topps Holiday Football gives collectors another fun way to collect the same rookies found in other releases this season, wrapped in a festive design. Who is Topps Holiday Football for? Topps Holiday Football is built for casual collectors, gift-givers, and anyone who wants a lower-cost way to open packs during the season. It also appeals to set collectors and Holiday completionists who already track down the baseball and basketball versions each year. New collectors will find it approachable, while longtime hobbyists get another checklist to complete before the year wraps up. What to Collect in 2026 Topps Holiday Football 2026 Topps Holiday Football takes the Flagship Football design and adds a full slate of winter-themed inserts. Collectors can look for Snow Globe Moments, which frame big on-field plays inside a snow globe design; Deck the Fields, featuring festive, garland-trimmed cards celebrating players across the league; Frozen Fields, a frosty, ice-themed set built around winter football imagery; and Dear Santa, a holiday letter-themed insert spotlighting top rookies and stars. Topps Holiday Football Collector FAQs Why is Topps Holiday Football so significant? What inserts are in 2026 Topps Holiday Football? When does 2026 Topps Holiday Football release? Which rookies will be featured in 2026 Topps Holiday Football? Key Facts Brand: Topps Holiday Football Debut: 2026, the first Topps Holiday release for football History: Topps Holiday began with baseball in 2016 and added basketball for 2025-26 Insert Highlights: Snow Globe Moments, Deck the Fields, Frozen Fields, and Dear Santa Collector Appeal: Casual collectors, gift-givers, and Holiday set completionists Focus: An accessible, festive entry point into NFL collecting

2026 Topps Holiday Football Collector Guide: Fernando Mendoza RCs & More Discover the Top Cards from Topps Holiday Football DATE: OCT 9, 2026 TOPICS: 2026 TOPPS HOLIDAY FOOTBALL, COLLECTOR GUIDE, FOOTBALL, NFL, PRODUCT, TOPPS HOLIDAY FOOTBALL, TRENDING LENGTH: 843 WORDS READING TIME: ~5 MINUTES 2026 Topps Holiday Football rings in the festive season with cheer, color, and unique designs. A debut release, the set combines the best of The Hobby with the best of the holidays. With good tidings and great players, Holiday Football showcases a loaded 2026 NFL rookie class and the biggest superstars in the sport. Whether you’re giving the gift of The Hobby, or sharing in your favorite tradition of ripping packs, this release brings the joy of the holidays to the gridiron. DISCOVER TOPPS HOLIDAY FOOTBALL Learn more about the Topps Holiday Football debut here, and keep reading for a deeper dive into the seasonal designs, quality ink, unique relics, and superstar power coming under the tree. 2026 Topps Holiday Football debuts with a 200-card base set and a compelling checklist — Holiday Spirit Variations, Dear Santa, Hidden Elf, Deck the Fields, and Snow Globe Moments — featuring NFL superstars Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes alongside top rookies Fernando Mendoza, Carnell Tate, and Arvell Reese – are just some of the highlights. Let’s take a closer look at the top cards to collect in 2026 Topps Holiday Football. Jump to Section Base Set | Holiday Spirit Variations | Dear Santa | Hidden Elf | Deck the Fields | Snow Globe Moments | FAQs | Key Facts Base Set 2026 Topps Holiday Football kicks off the celebration with a 200-card base set, including 150 veterans and 50 rookies. Top freshmen like Fernando Mendoza lead the way, alongside NFL superstars Josh Allen, Patrick Mahomes, Bijan Robinson, and more, all with the new holiday theme. Beautiful parallels help bring the set to life with both color and rarity. Look out for this stunning color match from Arizona Cardinals phenom Jeremiyah Love. Collectors can also celebrate the season in chromium, with Base Card Chrome Variations available for the entire base set. Holiday Spirit Variations Holiday Spirit Variations bring collectors designs inspired by the holidays. The seasonal imagery variation cards feature star quarterbacks like Joe Burrow and NFL MVP Matt Stafford. Look out for Rookie Holiday Spirit Variations from 10 of the top rookies in a loaded class. Talented linebacker Arvell Reese of the New York Giants is here to be found, along with phenoms Kenyon Sadiq of the Jets and Caleb Downs of the Cowboys. Dear Santa Dear Santa is a perfect marriage of design, innovation, and theme. This auto relic subset is inspired by the enduring holiday tradition of writing a letter to Santa Claus. The players here, all rookies (including Fernando Mendoza and Carnell Tate), sign their wish list for the upcoming season. It’s playful design that includes quality ink and memorabilia, giving the set some of its headline cards with a unique holiday twist. Hidden Elf Hidden Elf is another fun design that places holiday elves around the player, set into the base design. The 25-card subset features superstars Josh Allen, Lamar Jackson, Ja’Marr Chase, and more. Deck the Fields 2026 Topps Holiday Football brings the festivities right onto the gridiron with the beautiful 25-card insert Deck The Fields. Players are set against a football field that has been given the full holiday decoration treatment. Christian McCaffrey is here to be found, as well as rising young quarterbacks Tyler Shough, Drake Maye, Bo Nix, and more. Snow Globe Moments Snow Globe Moments is another shining example of the unique designs in 2026 Topps Holiday Football. Inspired by one of the most iconic holiday decorations, these cards feel like a beautiful winter night in the holiday season. Bijan Robinson is one of the headliners in this subset, along with Josh Allen and Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
